description: This file defines a custom exception class 'LeaveAllocationServiceException' within the 'OrangeHRM\Leave\Exception' namespace, providing static methods to generate specific exception instances related to leave allocation errors in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: LeaveAllocationServiceException
classes.description: A custom exception class for handling leave allocation related errors in the OrangeHRM leave module, providing static factory methods for specific error scenarios.

methods.name: overlappingLeavesFound
methods.description: Creates an instance of LeaveAllocationServiceException indicating that overlapping leave requests were found.

methods.name: workShiftLengthExceeded
methods.description: Creates an instance of LeaveAllocationServiceException indicating that the work shift length was exceeded.

methods.name: leaveBalanceExceeded
methods.description: Creates an instance of LeaveAllocationServiceException indicating that the leave balance was exceeded.

methods.name: leaveQuotaWillExceed
methods.description: Creates an instance of LeaveAllocationServiceException indicating that the leave quota will be exceeded.

methods.name: noWorkingDaysSelected
methods.description: Creates an instance of LeaveAllocationServiceException indicating that no working days were selected.

methods.name: cannotApplyLeaveBeyondMaxAllowedLeavePeriodEndDate
methods.description: Creates an instance of LeaveAllocationServiceException indicating that applying leave beyond the maximum allowed leave period end date.

methods.name: cannotAssignLeaveBeyondMaxAllowedLeavePeriodEndDate
methods.description: Creates an instance of LeaveAllocationServiceException indicating that assigning leave beyond the maximum allowed leave period end date.
